mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as elevated rates compress equity valuations through increased discount rates and heightened risk aversion.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS is above its 5-year median.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL value above 200 is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as high inflation triggers central bank tightening and equity market risk aversion.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 200.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4.0% and GDP growth (GDPC1) exceeds 11400 billion dollars, S&P 500 forward returns are positive over the next 20 trading days, reflecting late-cycle economic strength and equity market optimism.
failure_condition: In more than 40% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0 and GDPC1 > 11400, the 20-day returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising > 0.2% over 3 months), S&P 500 forward returns are negative over the next 20 trading days, as central bank policy shifts increase risk aversion and reduce equity multiples.
failure_condition: In more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises > 0.2% in 3 months, the 20-day returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1600 thousand units, S&P 500 forward returns are positive over the next 20 trading days, as strong housing activity signals robust consumer demand and economic expansion.
failure_condition: In more than 40% of instances where HOUST > 1600, the 20-day returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) exceeds 112.5, S&P 500 forward returns are positive over the next 20 trading days, as strong manufacturing output indicates robust economic activity and corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: In more than 40% of instances where INDPRO > 112.5, the 20-day returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1600 thousand units and residential fixed investment (RSAFS) exceeds 370000 million dollars, S&P 500 forward returns are positive over the next 20 trading days, as combined strength in housing and residential investment signals robust consumer sector expansion.
failure_condition: In more than 40% of instances where HOUST > 1600 and RSAFS > 370000, the 20-day returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4.0%, S&P 500 forward returns are positive over the next 5 trading days, as low unemployment signals a tight labor market and strong consumer spending, boosting equity market sentiment.
failure_condition: In more than 40% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0, the 5-day returns are negative.
